### FVCBankcorp, Inc. Announces Earnings; 19% Increase in Net Income Compared to Year Ago Quarter


October 22, 2026


FAIRFAX, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


FVCBankcorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: FVCB) (the “Company”) today reported net income of $6.6 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 compared to net income of $5.6 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, an increase of $1.0 million, or 19%. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, net income increased $4.8 million, or 29%, to $21.2 million, compared to $16.4 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.


Diluted earnings per share was $0.37 for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 compared to $0.31 for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, an increase of 20%. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, diluted earnings per share was $1.17, an increase of 30%, compared to diluted earnings per share of $0.90 for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.


Return on average assets for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 was 1.17%, an increase from 1.00% for the year ago quarter ended September 30, 2025. Return on average equity increased to 9.77% for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 9.05% for the year ago quarter ended September 30, 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, return on average assets was 1.27%, an increase from 0.98% for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. Return on average equity for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was 10.77%, an increase from 9.01% for the same period of 2025.


**Third Quarter Selected Financial Highlights**


- **Net Interest Margin Increased to 3.32%, Up 14% Compared to the Year Ago Quarter.** For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, net interest margin improved 41 basis points to 3.32% from 2.91% for the three months ended September 30, 2025.
- **Cost of Funds Continues to Decline.** The Company's cost of funds decreased to 2.42% for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, a decrease of 36 basis points from 2.78% for the year ago quarter ended September 30, 2025, and a decrease of 5 basis points from the linked quarter ended June 30, 2026.
- **Efficiency Ratio Improved to 53.29% for the Current Quarter.** The efficiency ratio decreased 4% to 53.29% for the third quarter of 2026 compared to 55.50% for the same period of 2025.
- **Loans Increased 3% Year-Over-Year.** Loans, net of fees, increased $55.5 million, or 3%, to $1.91 billion at September 30, 2026 compared to $1.86 billion at September 30, 2025, and increased $14.6 million, when compared to June 30, 2026.
- **Noninterest-Bearing Deposits Grew 14% Year-Over-Year.** Noninterest-bearing deposits increased $52.9 million, or 14%, to $427.3 million at September 30, 2026 compared to $374.4 million at September 30, 2025, and were 21% of total deposits at September 30, 2026.
- **Continued Solid Credit Quality.** Watchlist loans decreased $32.4 million, or 56%, to $25.5 million at September 30, 2026 compared to prior quarter end. Nonperforming loans at September 30, 2026 decreased to $11.0 million from $11.4 million at June 30, 2026. Nonperforming loans to total assets were 0.48% at September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025.
- **Sound, Well Capitalized Balance Sheet.** Total risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets for FVCbank (the “Bank”) was 16.61% at September 30, 2026, compared to 15.38% at December 31, 2025. The tangible common equity ("TCE") to tangible assets ("TA") ratio for the Bank was 11.99% at September 30, 2026, up from 11.38% at December 31, 2025. The Bank’s investment securities are classified as available-for-sale, and therefore the unrealized losses on these securities are fully reflected in the TCE/TA ratio.
- **Quarterly Cash Dividend.** On October 15, 2026, the Company declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.07 for each share of its common stock outstanding. The dividend is payable on November 16, 2026 to shareholders of record on October 26, 2026. Based on the current number of shares outstanding, the aggregate payment will be approximately $1.3 million.


**Management Comments**


David W. Pijor, Esq., Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of the Company, said:


“The third quarter was another quarter of strong performance. Our focus on diversifying our loan portfolio has contributed to the reduction in our commercial real estate concentrations to 275% of risk-based capital, the lowest in our recent history. Our loan pipeline is very strong giving us solid momentum going into the fourth quarter to continue to selectively grow our loan portfolio and customer base, balance sheet, earnings and shareholder value.”


Patricia A. Ferrick, President of the Company, said:


“Our continuing strong bank operating financial results reflect both the successful execution of our strategic initiatives and our continued commitment to deliver enhanced value to our shareholders and our customers. We are inspired by our team's passion and expertise to deliver best in class service to our growing relationship driven customer base."


**Statement of Condition**


Total assets were $2.31 billion at September 30, 2026, $2.29 billion at December 31, 2025, and $2.32 billion at September 30, 2025.


Loans, net of fees, were $1.91 billion at September 30, 2026, $1.94 billion at December 31, 2025, and $1.86 billion at September 30, 2025. During the most recent quarter, loans, net of fees, increased $14.6 million. Compared to the year ago period ended September 30, 2025, loans, net of fees, increased $55.5 million, or 3%. For the third quarter of 2026, loan originations totaled $71.2 million with a weighted average rate of 7.02%. Loan renewals totaled $61.3 million and had a weighted average rate of 6.84%. Loans that paid off during the third quarter of 2026 totaled $62.6 million and had a weighted average rate of 5.89%, and were primarily comprised of commercial real estate ("CRE") and construction loans. The outstanding balance of the Company’s warehouse lending facilities increased $3.7 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 to end at $71.0 million and had a weighted average yield of 5.76%.


Investment securities were $138.9 million at September 30, 2026, $153.4 million at December 31, 2025, and $157.2 million at September 30, 2025. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, investment securities decreased due to principal repayments totaling $4.8 million, partially offset by purchases of $1.0 million, and an increase in the portfolio’s unrealized losses totaling $4.5 million due to rising interest rates.


Total deposits were $2.00 billion at September 30, 2026, $2.00 billion at December 31, 2025, and $1.98 billion at September 30, 2025. For the third quarter of 2026, total deposits decreased $55.2 million, or 3%. Core deposits, which exclude wholesale deposits, decreased $45.1 million, or 2%, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Noninterest-bearing deposits increased $12.0 million, or 3%, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and were 21.0% of total deposits. The decrease in core deposits for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 was primarily due to large customer deposit transactions that occurred at the end of the second quarter, and therefore, the decrease in core deposits at September 30, 2026 was expected. At September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, reciprocal deposits, which are mostly comprised of interest checking and savings accounts, totaled $210.6 million and $291.8 million, respectively, and are considered part of the Company’s core deposit base.


At September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, wholesale deposits totaled $231.1 million and $285.0 million, respectively, a decrease of $53.8 million or 19% from year end. For the third quarter of 2026, wholesale deposits decreased $10.0 million, or 4%. Wholesale deposits at September 30, 2026 had a weighted average rate of 3.51%.


Shareholders’ equity at September 30, 2026 was $268.5 million, $253.6 million at December 31, 2025, and $249.8 million at September 30, 2025. Shareholders’ equity at September 30, 2026 increased $14.9 million, or 6%, from December 31, 2025. Earnings for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 contributed $21.2 million to the increase in shareholders’ equity. The increase to shareholders’ equity from earnings was partially offset by increased cash dividends paid during 2026 totaling $3.6 million and shares repurchased during 2026 totaling $2.1 million. Accumulated other comprehensive loss increased $3.5 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, and is attributable to market value decreases in the Company’s available-for-sale investment securities portfolio.


Tangible book value per share (a non-GAAP financial measure which is defined in the tables below) at September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025 was $14.49 and $13.74, respectively, an increase of 5%.


The Bank was well-capitalized at September 30, 2026, with a total risk-based capital ratio of 16.66%, a common equity tier 1 risk-based capital ratio of 15.64%, and a tier 1 leverage ratio of 13.08%.


**Asset Quality**


For the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, the Company recorded a provision for credit losses totaling $186 thousand and $375 thousand, respectively. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, provision for credit losses was $596 thousand and $680 thousand, respectively. At September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, the allowance for credit losses (“ACL”) was $18.8 million and $18.9 million, respectively. The ACL to total loans, net of fees, was 0.98% at September 30, 2026, compared to 0.97% at December 31, 2025. Excluding the warehouse facilities, the ACL to loans ratio was 1.02% and 0.99% at September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively. The Company recorded net charge-offs of $499 thousand for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to net charge-offs of $876 thousand for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.


The Company assesses credit risks proactively within its loan portfolio through its established portfolio monitoring programs, working diligently with its customers to minimize losses. At September 30, 2026, the Company’s watchlist loans totaled $25.5 million, a decrease of $32.4 million, or 56%, compared to $57.9 million at December 31, 2025. The decrease in watchlist loans is primarily a result of sufficiently improved performance of a construction loan totaling $31.3 million. The Company continues to work with its watchlist borrowers and believes there will be satisfactory resolution to each of these loans.


Nonperforming loans at September 30, 2026 totaled $11.0 million, or 0.48% of total assets, compared to $10.9 million, or 0.48% of total assets, at December 31, 2025. The Company had no other real estate owned at each of September 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025.


**Commercial Real Estate Portfolio**


The regulatory concentration ratio of CRE and construction loans to total risk-based capital was 275% and the ratio of construction loans to total risk-based capital was 45%, at September 30, 2026.


At September 30, 2026, CRE loans totaled $935.3 million, or 49% of total loans, net of fees, and construction loans totaled $143.8 million, or 8% of total loans, net of fees. Included in CRE loans are loans secured by office properties totaling $126.9 million, or 7% of total loans, which are primarily located in the Virginia and Maryland suburbs of the Company’s market area, with $959 thousand, or 0.05% of total loans, located in Washington, D.C. Loans secured by retail properties totaled $206.8 million, or 11% of total loans, at September 30, 2026, with $8.5 million, or 0.45% of total loans, located in Washington, D.C. Loans secured by multi-family properties totaled $176.7 million, or 9% of total loans, at September 30, 2026, with $76.2 million, or 4% of total loans, located in Washington, D.C. (a decrease from $98.7 million at December 31, 2025). The CRE portfolio, including construction loans, is diversified by asset type and geographic concentration.


The Company manages the CRE portfolio in a disciplined manner, and has comprehensive policies to monitor, measure, and mitigate its loan concentrations within this portfolio segment, including rigorous credit approval, monitoring and administrative practices. **Minority Investment in Mortgage Banking Operation**


For the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, the Company recorded a loss of $403 thousand and income of $508 thousand, respectively, related to its investment in Atlantic Coast Mortgage, LLC ("ACM"). For the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, income from ACM totaled $437 thousand and $999 thousand, respectively. The decrease in income for 2026 as compared to 2025 is primarily due to the recent increase in mortgage interest rates. ACM's loan originations for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 increased 64% compared to the same period ended September 30, 2025.


The Company’s investment in ACM is reflected as a nonconsolidated minority investment, and as such, the Company’s income generated from the investment is included in noninterest income.


**Income Statement**


The Company recorded net income of $6.6 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to net income of $5.6 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025, an increase of $1.0 million, or 19%. Compared to the linked quarter, net income for the three months ended September 30, 2026 decreased $1.6 million, or 19%, from $8.2 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026. The Company recorded net income of $21.2 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to net income of $16.4 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025, an increase of $4.8 million, or 30%. Included in net income for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 is a one-time pre-tax gain of $847 thousand attributable to the completed sale of the Bank’s interest in Bearing Insurance Group, LLC to an unaffiliated third party that occurred in the second quarter of 2026.


Net interest income increased $2.4 million, or 15%, to $18.4 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to $16.0 million for the same period of 2025, and decreased $715 thousand, or 4%, compared to the linked quarter ended June 30, 2026. Net interest income for the third quarter of 2026 decreased as net interest income for the second quarter of 2026 included $1.0 million in loan prepayment fee income. Excluding this prepayment fee income, net interest income for the third quarter of 2026 increased $285 thousand, or 2%. The increase in net interest income for the third quarter of 2026 compared to the year ago quarter was due to an increase in interest income from both increased yields and average loans receivable combined with a decrease in interest expense on deposits.


The Company's net interest margin increased 41 basis points to 3.32% for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 compared to 2.91% for the quarter ended September 30, 2025. The increase in net interest margin from a year ago is a result of scheduled repricing and maturities of its loans receivable portfolio along with improvement in the cost of funding sources. Compared to the linked quarter ended June 30, 2026, net interest margin decreased 21 basis points from 3.53%. As previously mentioned, net interest income for the second quarter of 2026 included $1.0 million in loan fees related to the prepayment of a commercial real estate loan. When excluding these loan fees, net interest margin was 3.35% for the second quarter of 2026, which was 3 basis points higher than the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Compared to the linked quarter, net interest income for the third quarter of 2026 was impacted by a decrease in average loans, which decreased $50.7 million, as expected loan closings were rescheduled to the fourth quarter of 2026 due to customary closing delays. The funds available for the delayed loan originations were temporarily invested in lower yielding interest-bearing deposits at other financial institutions, which increased the average balance by $83.4 million during the third quarter of 2026 compared to the linked quarter ended June 30, 2026.


Compared to the year ago quarter, interest income increased $583 thousand, or 2%, to $30.4 million, for the third quarter of 2026, and decreased $671 thousand, or 2%, compared to the linked quarter ended June 30, 2026. Loan interest income increased $1.0 million, or 4%, to $28.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $27.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. This increase in loan interest income was a result of both an increase in average loans and an increase in the yields earned as loans are originated or renewed at higher interest rates compared to maturing loans. The yield on loans increased 9 basis points to 5.99% for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to 5.90% for the same period of 2025, and increased 6 basis points when compared to the linked quarter ended June 30, 2026, when excluding the aforementioned $1.0 million in loan fees recorded for the commercial real estate loan prepayment during the second quarter of 2026.


The Company anticipates a continued increase in loan yields due to scheduled loan repricings and maturities. Within 12 months of September 30, 2026, $152.6 million in fixed rate commercial loans with a weighted average rate of 5.30% and $39.4 million in variable rate commercial loans with a weighted average rate of 4.07% are expected to reprice or mature. Within the following 24-36 months of September 30, 2026, $299.7 million in fixed rate commercial loans with a weighted average rate of 5.93% and an additional $109.6 million in variable rate commercial loans with a weighted average rate of 5.92% are scheduled to reprice or mature. In the near-term, the Company’s efforts to attain appropriate yields on new originations and the repricing of the commercial loan portfolio are expected to provide continued improvement in loan yields.


Interest expense decreased $1.8 million, or 13%, to $12.0 million, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to $13.8 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, which is primarily attributable to the decrease in deposit costs. Interest expense on deposits decreased $1.6 million to $11.5 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $13.1 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. On a linked quarter basis, interest expense on deposits increased $131 thousand, or 1%, compared to the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The cost of deposits (which includes noninterest-bearing deposits) for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 was 2.36%, a decrease of 33 basis points from the year ago quarter ended September 30, 2025, and a decrease of 4 basis points compared to the linked quarter ended June 30, 2026, demonstrating the Company's ability to grow its customer base while reducing deposit costs.


Interest expense on other borrowed funds for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 decreased $475 thousand, to $3 thousand from $478 thousand, for the quarter ended September 30, 2025. Compared to the linked quarter ended June 30, 2026, interest expense on other borrowed funds decreased $93 thousand for the third quarter of 2026. Interest expense on long-term debt for the three months ended September 30, 2026, June 30, 2026, and September 30, 2025, was $482 thousand, $476 thousand, and $245 thousand, respectively. During the first quarter of 2026, the Company redeemed $18.8 million of its subordinated debt and issued $25 million of senior unsecured notes, which pay a fixed rate of 6.75%.


The cost of interest-bearing liabilities for the third quarter of 2026 was 3.04% compared to 3.41% for the third quarter of 2025, a decrease of 37 basis points, and compared to the linked quarter ended June 30, 2026, decreased 3 basis points from 3.07%. Cost of funds, which includes noninterest-bearing deposits, decreased to 2.42% for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, a decrease from 2.47% for the linked quarter ended June 30, 2026, and a decrease from 2.78% for the year ago quarter ended September 30, 2025.


Net interest income for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 was $55.0 million and $46.8 million, respectively, an increase of $8.1 million, or 17%, year-over-year. Interest income increased $3.5 million, or 4%, to $91.3 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $87.8 million for the comparable 2025 period. Interest expense totaled $36.3 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, a decrease of $4.6 million, or 11%, compared to $41.0 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. The Company’s net interest margin for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was 3.37% compared to 2.88% for the year-ago nine month period of 2025, an increase of 49 basis points, or 17%.


Noninterest income for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 totaled $303 thousand and $1.0 million, respectively. Compared to the linked quarter, noninterest income for the third quarter of 2026 decreased from $2.2 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026. The decrease in noninterest income during the most recent quarter is primarily attributable to a pre-tax gain of $847 thousand recorded during the second quarter of 2026 from the completed sale of the Bank’s interest in Bearing Insurance Group, LLC to an unaffiliated third party. Additionally, the Company recorded a $403 thousand loss from its minority membership interest related to ACM during the third quarter of 2026.


Service charges on deposit accounts totaled $475 thousand for the third quarter of 2026, an increase of $154 thousand, or 48%, compared to $321 thousand for the year ago quarter, and increased $49 thousand, or 12%, when compared to $426 thousand for the linked quarter ended June 30, 2026. The increase in service charges for the most recent quarter is a result of an increase in the Bank's fees during 2026 in addition to an increase in transactional activity from new and existing customers.


For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company recorded noninterest income of $3.3 million, compared to $2.7 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025, an increase of $627 thousand, or 23%. Fee income from loans was $238 thousand for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $145 thousand for the same period of 2025. Service charges on deposit accounts totaled $1.3 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $873 thousand for the nine months ended September 30, 2025, an increase of $391 thousand, or 45%. Income from the Company's minority interest in ACM was $437 thousand for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $999 thousand for the same period of 2025, a decrease of $562 thousand. Included in net income for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 is a one-time pre-tax gain of $847 thousand attributable to the completed sale of the Bank’s interest in Bearing Insurance Group, LLC to an unaffiliated third party that occurred in the second quarter of 2026.


Noninterest expense totaled $10.0 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, an increase of $514 thousand, or 5%, compared to $9.5 million for the year ago quarter ended September 30, 2025. On a linked quarter basis, noninterest expense decreased $603 thousand, or 6%, from $10.6 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026. Compared to the year ago quarter, salaries and benefits expense increased $419 thousand, or 8%, for the three months ended September 30, 2026. The increase in salaries and benefits expense when compared to the year ago quarter was primarily a result of the addition of lending and business development personnel and the filling of vacant positions, along with an increase in other incentive accruals and equity compensation vesting during the third quarter of 2026. Full-time equivalent employees have increased from 118 at September 30, 2025, and 122 at December 31, 2025, to 134 at September 30, 2026. The decrease in salaries and benefits expense for the third quarter of 2026 as compared to the linked quarter ended June 30, 2026 was due to decreased expense related to payroll taxes, equity compensation and incentives.


Internet banking and software expense increased $35 thousand to $925 thousand for the third quarter of 2026 compared to $890 thousand for the year ago quarter ended September 30, 2025, and increased $41 thousand compared to the linked quarter ended June 30, 2026. Data processing and network administration expense increased $2 thousand to $561 thousand for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 when compared to the year ago quarter, and decreased $135 thousand when compared to the linked quarter ended June 30, 2026. The Company is focused on operating efficiencies and diligently identifying opportunities to reduce expenses.


For the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, noninterest expense was $30.4 million and $28.0 million, respectively, an increase of $2.4 million, or 9%, primarily as a result of the aforementioned increases in salaries and benefits expense due to the increase in lending and business development personnel and decrease in vacant positions.


The efficiency ratios for the quarters ended September 30, 2026, June 30, 2026, and September 30, 2025, were 53.3%, 49.7%, and 55.5%, respectively. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, the efficiency ratio was 52.2% and 56.6%, respectively. Excluding the gain on the sale of minority interest of $847 thousand recorded during the second quarter of 2026, the adjusted efficiency ratio for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was 52.6%. A reconciliation of the aforementioned adjusted efficiency ratio, a non-GAAP financial measure, can be found in the tables below.


The Company recorded a provision for income taxes of $1.9 million and $1.6 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively. The effective tax rates for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 were 22.5% and 22.7%, respectively. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, provision for income taxes was $6.0 million and $4.4 million, respectively, and the effective tax rates for those same periods were 22.1% and 21.3%, respectively.


**About FVCBankcorp, Inc.**


FVCBankcorp, Inc. is the holding company for FVCbank, a wholly-owned subsidiary that commenced operations in November 2007. FVCBank is a $2.31 billion asset-sized Virginia-chartered community bank serving the banking needs of commercial businesses, nonprofit organizations, professional service entities, their owners and employees located in the greater Baltimore and Washington, D.C. metropolitan areas. FVCbank is based in Fairfax, Virginia, and has 8 full-service offices in Arlington, Fairfax, Manassas, Reston and Springfield, Virginia, Washington, D.C., and Baltimore, and Bethesda, Maryland.
